transcript.statement: The SafetyAgent emphasizes the importance of safety and reliability in the library management system. requirements.text: The system shall implement a unified digital notification system for overdue books, ensuring timely alerts and minimizing paper waste.
The system shall enforce a maximum borrowing limit of 5 books per member to ensure fairness and resource management.
The system shall ensure compliance with data protection regulations through encryption of member data.
The system shall provide an accessible interface for all users, promoting fairness and inclusivity.
The system shall log all user actions related to borrowing and returning books for accountability.
The system shall provide an annual report on usage statistics to ensure transparency in library operations.
The system shall enable searching for books with a response time of under 2 seconds for 95% of queries.
The system shall track book availability and update the status in real-time to ensure accurate information.
The system shall process book returns within 1 second to maintain high throughput.
The system shall maintain an uptime of 99.5% to ensure consistent availability for users.
The system shall ensure only registered members can access borrowing features through a user authentication process.
The system shall allow librarians to revoke borrowing privileges for members with outstanding overdue books.
The system shall implement a mechanism for members to report issues or suggestions regarding fairness in library services.
The system shall prioritize the acquisition of e-books to reduce physical resource consumption.
The system shall track energy savings achieved through digital operations compared to traditional methods.
